product.name: Online Coding Classes for Kids
product.description: Live 1:1 online coding classes for students aged 6 to 18, covering programming fundamentals and advanced topics using various languages and tools.

product.name: STEM & AI Accredited Curriculum
product.description: A structured curriculum integrating STEM and AI concepts, designed to teach coding and computational thinking through real-world projects.

product.name: Game Development Courses
product.description: Courses teaching game design and programming using tools like Unity and Roblox, aimed at developing technical and creative skills in game creation.

product.name: Mobile App Development Courses
product.description: Instruction in mobile app development covering native and cross-platform approaches, including Flutterflow and Dart programming.

product.name: Python and Data Science Courses
product.description: Courses focused on Python programming and data science concepts, including machine learning, computer vision, and data analysis.

product.name: 3D Coding (AR, VR) Courses
product.description: Courses teaching 3D programming and development for augmented and virtual reality environments.
